grading_standard.correct: Every asked material fact resolved correctly with summary support; assess all substantive fields.
grading_standard.context: Question-given scenario facts are givens. Contextual background is not an extra asked requirement.

answers.expected_answer: Shuffle asset, demand, event and investment decks separately and separate/shuffle the five action types. Draw one shuffled setup card, placing one listed component in each listed district and its upper-right count of facedown assets on turn slots starting at1; box all setup cards. Round1, resources0, revealed demand targets as printed, threat0. Choose corporations and correct4 or5–6 side, matching faceup emergency, draw sheet cards. Random capital token chooses active player, who starts10 capital; clockwise11,12,etc. Shuffle used-corporation rivals plus Federalist, deal one secretly each, set extra partly under board. Each draws2 investments, keeps1 facedown, returns other facedown to deck top; create reserve.
required_facts: separate four non-action decks and five action decks
random setup card component placements and asset count in lowest slots; box setup cards
round1 resources0 demand revealed targets threat0
choose corporation matching emergency faceup correct player-count sheet and initial sheet draw
random active player capital10 then clockwise11 upwards
used corporation rivals plus Federalist secret one each and extra under board
investment draw2 keep1 facedown other top; reserve
source_refs: RR p2 Complete Setup steps1–12; RR21.1

discard to5 excluding emergencies then pass left
empty track at turn end ends Action Phase

answers.expected_answer: Reveal highest-numbered/rightmost turn-track asset. Active player must propose one faceup hand action or faceup emergency; cannot pass. Others each get one clockwise counteroffer chance from active player’s left. Supporting players each get one clockwise support/abstain chance. Most facedown support wins, main offer wins ties. Winner resolves offer then claims asset faceup; all played action cards discarded facedown to shared pile, emergencies returned to original owners face down if winning, face up otherwise.
required_facts: mandatory faceup main hand action or emergency
one clockwise counteroffer chance excluding active
effect before faceup asset claim then facedown shared discard and emergency original-owner state
